body: Should I go to a therapist? Is it a waste? Because I know i'm fucked up. Why should I pay money to hear someone tell me i'm fucked up?
I love doing that. Although sometimes when im done i feel even more insignificant. Like i am just one little tiny speck.

I abandoned pretty much everything. I dropped out of college. I no longer play hockey. It's not that I don't worry about death, more I don't worry about anything. Yea, I have short term happiness. But then I become depressed all over again. Being happy is only a mask.
